# polaris_policy (Resource)

Manages a Polaris policy, defined in a namespace and applied to catalogs, namespaces or tables with `polaris_policy_attachment`. A policy can only be destroyed once it is no longer attached.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_namespace" "governance" {
  catalog   = "lakehouse"
  namespace = ["governance"]
}

resource "polaris_policy" "compaction" {
  catalog     = polaris_namespace.governance.catalog
  namespace   = polaris_namespace.governance.namespace
  name        = "nightly-compaction"
  type        = "system.data-compaction"
  description = "Compact small files every night"

  content = jsonencode({
    version = "2025-02-03"
    enable  = true
    config = {
      "target_file_size_bytes" = 134217728
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The name of the catalog. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `content` (String) The policy definition, a JSON document validated against the schema of `type` (use `jsonencode`). Polaris stores it as written.
- `name` (String) The name of the policy: letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace the policy is defined in, as an ordered list of levels. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `type` (String) The policy type: `system.data-compaction`, `system.metadata-compaction`, `system.orphan-file-removal` or `system.snapshot-expiry`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the policy.

### Read-Only

- `inheritable` (Boolean) Whether the policy applies to the children of the entities it is attached to. Set by Polaris from the policy type.
- `version` (Number) Version of the policy, incremented on every update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a policy by catalog, namespace path and name, separated by "/".
terraform import polaris_policy.compaction lakehouse/governance/nightly-compaction
```
